key_insight: Resolving ReLU activation boundaries enables correct loss gradients for PDE training where standard sampling-based integration can fail even with arbitrarily many points.
engineering_relevance: Geometry-aware integration can make neural PDE solvers more reliable when their loss depends on spatial derivatives of piecewise-linear networks.
method: Partition the domain along single-hidden-layer ReLU breaking hyperplanes using Sutherland–Hodgman clipping.
Assemble the energy in matrix–vector form to efficiently compute neuron interactions.
Introduce Conforming Monte Carlo and two stochastic training strategies to reduce complexity.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments on two-dimensional domains recover optimal PDE solutions that standard stochastic sampling and other tested quadrature methods fail to capture.
watch_item: The framework targets single-hidden-layer networks; scalability to deeper architectures and higher-dimensional domains is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Exact Integration of ReLU-type Neural Networks for Solving PDEs
